newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare Tech shareholder sells stake.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Tech shareholder sells stake.

text.p: Healthcare Technologies Ltd said Friday its largest shareholder, Rosebud Medical Ltd, had agreed to swap its about 25 percent stake in Healthcare Tech for certain assets of Gamida for Life BV.
Rosebud's board and audit committee have approved the transaction, Healthcare Tech said. The deal is also subject to approval by Rosebud shareholders and regulatory authorities, it said.

The transaction, together with a previously announced agreement for Healthcare Tech to acquire the Gamidor companies from Gamida, will result in Gamida owning about 43 percent of Healthcare Tech's outstanding shares, the company said.
Healthcare Tech has scheduled an extraordinary meeting of shareholders on March 25 to consider and vote on the previously announced Gamidor transaction.

Gamida is a holding company of the privately owned Gamida Group in Rotterdam, Netherlands, which engages in research, development, production and distribution of products and services for health care.

Healthcare Tech, through its subsidiaries Savyon Diagnostics, Diatech Diagnostic Ltd, Diatech Diagnostics Inc and Gamidor UK, specializes in the development, manufacture and marketing of medical diagnostic testing kits for certain diseases and infections.
